title: Welcome to Cyber Security Central! 🔐
description: Cybersecurity is about keeping information safe! Just like locking your diary or having a secret password for your treehouse. In code, we protect data from bad ghosts who want to steal or break things.

concepts.name: What is Cybersecurity?
concepts.explanation: Cybersecurity means protecting computers and data from bad actors. It's like being a digital security guard!

concepts.name: Passwords and Authentication
concepts.explanation: Strong passwords are like strong locks. They should be long, unique, and hard to guess. Authentication checks if you're really who you say you are!
